# Global Optimization

![Global Optimization function icon](../../../../assets/function-icons/functions/math/optimization/global.svg)

[Mathematics functions](../../mathematics/index.md) · [All functions](../../index.md)

Searches bounded parameters by differential evolution and retains vector objectives and Pareto candidates; no global optimum guarantee.

<details>
<summary>Résumé français de l’aide Studio</summary>

**Recherche par évolution différentielle**

Explore des paramètres bornés par évolution différentielle et conserve les objectifs vectoriels et les candidats de Pareto ; aucun optimum global n’est garanti.

</details>

## Types and connection rules

Searches bounded parameters by differential evolution and retains vector objectives and Pareto candidates; no global optimum guarantee.

- Type resolution: `fixed`; result expression: `array<f64>`.
- Implicit coercion: not enabled by this resolver; individual port policies remain explicit.
- Arrays: accepted; lifting policy: `none`.
- Shape rule: `exact_real_dbl_rank_and_structured_constraint_signature`.
- Scalar lifting: no.

**Input count:** 8; this contract does not enable variadic inputs.
